mission.title: The Gatekeeper
mission.description: Bring dire lupines to the Effectuator and defend a construct portal from Zion.

npc.say: I'm quite certain there are Zionites nearby...

phase.briefing:
Ah, yes, {player}... I, ah... well you see, the data you recovered from those Zion operatives? Well, it somehow seems to have made its way back to them.
But now is not the time for pointing fingers. Now is the time for action! You must go to the location I've indicated and meet with some of your favorite new friends.

enter.say: There should be a couple of Dire Lupines in here... just pick them up and head out, and don't waste any time!

objective.text: Lead the first dire lupine out of the area
Lead the second dire lupine out of the area

phase.briefing: Now, simply lead those fleabags to the next location. The Effectuator is waiting there for you. No dallying!

enter.say: Keep an eye out, {player}. Those Zion operatives will be on their way.

wave.say: Keep looking -- I think there are some more attackers nearby...

objective.text: Lead the dire lupines to the Effectuator

done.say: Ah, ciao, {player}! I trust you have some of those delightful pups in tow?

You may not notice anything, but the portal is right here... at least it is for the moment. These portals really aren't too keen on staying put, to tell the truth. But I fear that those clever little Zion meddlers are on their way...
Okay -- this is it, I'm reading some inbound signals! Get ready!
All the attackers are down. Now you'd better check in with the Effectuator before you take off.

talk.say: Wonderful! Bravo! Ah, it is simply magnificent to see that the Merovingian's operatives can still pack a punch when they need to. According to my calculations, this portal is already waning and will soon be on its way to a new location... as will I. Thank you for your assistance, {player}... I will not forget this.

done.say: Nice work. You can't go wrong having friends high up in the Frenchman's organization.

mission.finish:
Well, I'm certain that the Merovingian will be proud to hear how my operative has saved the day. I really can spot talent, is it not so?
Until next time, {player}.
